tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: Free. Lists every tool, the data sources and licences, the coverage (US and UK) and the limits. No inputs.

tools.name: listing_location_pack
tools.description: Everything for one address in one call: drive times to the nearest town, cities and airports; people living within a 1, 2 and 4 hour drive (US Census 2020 or WorldPop 2020 UK); nearby lakes, rivers, coast, mountains, national parks and attractions with distances and drive minutes; waterfront and ins

tools.name: home_buyer_report
tools.description: Everything a home buyer asks about one address, in one call: nearby primary, middle, secondary and private schools (England: Ofsted grades or report cards, pupils, faith, selective; US: grades, pupils per teacher, free lunch share, and the school district the address is in), how admissions and catch

tools.name: schools_nearby
tools.description: Nearest schools by level (primary, middle, secondary, private, special, nursery) with miles, walk and drive minutes. England: every open school from the DfE register with the latest Ofsted grade or report card, type, ages, pupils, gender, faith and selective flag. US: every public school from NCES 2

tools.name: daily_needs
tools.description: Everyday places near an address from OpenStreetMap, in five groups: groceries (supermarket, corner shop), health (doctor or GP, pharmacy, dentist, hospital), getting around (train, metro, tram, bus, EV charging), kids and family (playground, park, childcare, library, sports centre) and out and about

tools.name: area_profile
tools.description: Who lives around an address. US: census tract median household income, home value, rent, median age, owner-occupied share, households with children, commute under 30 minutes, degree share and median year built (ACS 2020-2024), with the county, state and US figures to compare, plus county, place, ZIP

tools.name: flood_risk
tools.description: Flood zone at the exact point. US: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer zone (A, AE, V and so on mean high risk, where lenders usually require flood insurance; shaded X moderate). England: Environment Agency Flood Zone 1, 2 or 3 from rivers and the sea. Wales, Scotland and NI: a link to their own flood

tools.name: crime_nearby
tools.description: Crimes and anti-social behaviour recorded by police within 1 mile of an address in the latest published month (data.police.uk, England, Wales and Northern Ireland), by type, with the count within 400 m. Central London falls back to a quarter mile. US: says plainly that no free national crime data by

tools.description: How many people live within each drive time of an address, for example 1, 2 and 4 hours. US: 2020 Census block group populations. UK: WorldPop 2020 1 km grid. Drive times from the OSRM router on OpenStreetMap roads (minutes scaled to match Google Maps usual traffic). Returns the count per band, a re

tools.name: drive_times
tools.description: Drive minutes and road miles from an address to up to 20 places. Give destinations as names ("Utica, NY", "Manchester Airport") or {name, lat, lon}; leave them out to get the nearest town, nearest big cities and nearest airports automatically. OSRM router on OpenStreetMap roads, scaled to match Goog

tools.name: nearby_nature
tools.description: Notable named places near an address, grouped: lakes and reservoirs, rivers, coast and beaches, islands, mountains, national parks, parks and nature reserves, golf, ski and marinas, museums and attractions. Each with miles, direction and (by default) drive minutes. Says when the site is on the water

tools.name: plot_size
tools.description: Area of a site in acres, hectares, square feet and square metres, plus its perimeter. Pass a polygon (from a county parcel map, a deed plan or a drawing) for an exact figure, or just an address or lat and lon to measure the OpenStreetMap outline of the place at that point (for example a campground,

tools.name: map_image
tools.description: Links for a listing map: a US aerial photo of the site as a PNG (USGS National Map imagery, public domain, any width from 100 m to 5 km), a USGS topo map PNG, and Google Maps and OpenStreetMap links. In the UK only the map links are returned for now. Instant, no outside calls.

tools.name: locate_address
tools.description: Turns an address or UK postcode into latitude and longitude, with the matched address and the source (US Census Geocoder, postcodes.io or Nominatim). Use it to check the pin before the other tools.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: daily_needs · Private data: home_buyer_report, schools_nearby · Public sink: home_buyer_report, schools_nearby, daily_needs, area_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: daily_needs · Private data: home_buyer_report, schools_nearby · Public sink: home_buyer_report, schools_nearby, daily_needs, area_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
